title: Playful Teen at Patio Dining Counter, Car - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot from October 1955 depicting a family or group seated along a patio or screened porch dining counter. In the foreground, a young person wearing eyeglasses leans back playfully toward the camera, adding humor to the scene. The others, dressed in typical mid-1950s casual daywear including short-sleeved shirts, blouses, and an apron, sit facing away or in profile while conversing. Outside, the side profile of a 1950s American automobile is parked along the exterior wall. The print features classic scalloped deckled edges and binder hole punches at the top edge.
